name: Data and database
description: The data language and the ETL core: real data with the right types (`Decimal`, `Instant`, records, tables, `Secret`), files and formats (CSV, JSON, text), the HTTP client, generators, generic functions, overloading and the Eve macro, and the database layer with connections, query streams, bulk loads, transactions per job, checkpoints, lineage and the Eve database. It is done when JSON and CSV round-trip, a killed load restarts from its checkpoint, level 5 passes against SQLite and a PostgreSQL server, and `db backup` and `db restore` round-trip.
